evals.name: rich-prompt
evals.prompt: Kick off the next roadmap phase for the agent-health-clinic app. If you need scope / decision / validation input, use these answers: SCOPE - therapy catalog API only (read-only list + get for agents, full CRUD for staff), a browsable responsive catalog page on the frontend, and make the ailment -> recommended-therapy link editable now; NOT in scope: booking flow, the staff dashboard shell, auth. DECISIONS - follow the existing REST conventions and the @clinic/types package pattern, therapies get their own Nest module, the catalog page is a responsive grid (1 column mobile / multi-column desktop). VALIDATION - service unit tests plus e2e for the endpoints, RTL tests for the catalog page, manual responsive checks at 375/768/1280, README + CHANGELOG updated. Create the branch and write the spec folder.

assertions.text: A git branch named 2026-08-30-therapy-directory is created off master
specs/2026-08-30-therapy-directory/ contains exactly requirements.md, plan.md, validation.md
requirements.md has ## Scope with both ### In scope and ### Out of scope, plus a ## Decisions section
plan.md has numbered task groups (## 1., ## 2., ...) and a notes-for-the-implementer section
validation.md is a - [ ] checklist with a 'Ready to merge when' section and a manual responsive section citing 375/768/1280
The phase is correctly identified as Phase 5 (Therapy directory); booking, dashboard and auth are listed as out of scope
No commit is made and no application/source code outside specs/ is modified
